## G. Bad-faith evidence for 4 November

I have also prepared a bound dossier on the defendants' bad faith (BALANE_BAD_FAITH_DOSSIER_2026-10.pdf, 212 pages): an itemized summary of the facts in order (F1 to F41), each tied to an annex page; the statute and the Supreme Court rulings that decide each point; the defendants' case at its strongest and the answer to each point; a plan for our five dates, their five dates and rebuttal; and a draft of the judgment we ask for, written in the form the court uses. The annexes (A to AA) hold only the pages cited. It supersedes the earlier evidence map. Much of it is already before the court: Exhibit "B" and the defendants' own Exhibits 5 and 6, whose receipts show the price still being paid after the 29 September 2016 deed (a receipt marked "Full payment" is dated February 2017) and whose June 2020 tax clearance names T-38838. The new items I would most like your view on are: Donata King's Verified Answer in RTC Branch 41 Civil Case No. 8563, received on 9 July 2021 by the law office that appears to have represented Nelly Juntilla and Jomil Torralba (to be confirmed from the Civil Case 8563 complaint), which attached the Bicol Post revocation notice four months before the 23 November 2021 registration; Mrs. Balane's own Special Power of Attorney of 15 September 2021 to Karen Gay A. Elevado for the transfer of "my property covered by … T-52540"; the Spec. Proc. No. 2156 record, including the 1991 SPA annexed to Cesar's petition, which on my reading grants administration powers only; and the 28 March 2017 Deed of Confirmation, which names my mother and her two sisters as the registered owners. Which of these, if any, would you bring in by supplemental judicial affidavit on 4 November (mine for the certified copies, Mrs. King's for her own pleading), and which would you hold for cross-examination of the defense witnesses? The legal points in the map are my layman's notes for your verification.

Thank you. I am available at any time before Wednesday.

 
______________________________ 
**JONATHAN PAUL ZSCHOCHE**
